docs.title: API Reference
docs.text:
The TechDocsHub API allows developers to interact with tasks programmatically. All requests must be authenticated using an API token.

🔐 Authentication: Pass the token as a header: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE

docs.title: 📥 Get All Tasks📝 Create a New Task🗑️ Delete a Task
docs.text:
Endpoint: GET /api/tasks

Description: Returns a list of all tasks in the authenticated user's workspace.

Response Example: ```json [ { "id": "task-001", "title": "Design homepage", "status": "To Do", "priority": "High" }, { "id": "task-002", "title": "Fix login bug", "status": "In Progress", "priority": "Medium" } ]

Endpoint: POST /api/tasks

Headers:

Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE

Request Body:

{
  "title": "Write release notes",
  "description": "Cover all new features",
  "due_date": "2025-07-01",
  "priority": "High"
}

Success Response:

{
  "id": "task-003",
  "message": "Task created successfully."
}

Endpoint: DELETE /api/tasks/{id}

Description: Deletes the task with the specified ID.

Example Request:

DELETE /api/tasks/task-003
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN_HERE

Success Response:

{
  "message": "Task deleted successfully."
}

Note: Deleting a task is permanent and cannot be undone.

docs.title: 🔐 How do I reset my password?
docs.text: Go to the login page and click on “Forgot Password”. Enter your registered email, and you’ll receive a reset link within a few minutes.

docs.title: 📋 Why don’t I see any tasks after logging in?
docs.text: Make sure you’re in the correct workspace. You can switch workspaces from the sidebar. If the issue persists, contact your admin.

docs.title: 👥 Can I invite someone who doesn’t have an account yet?
docs.text: Yes! Go to Team → Invite Member, enter their email, and they’ll receive an invitation to join.

docs.title: 📎 Can I export my task data?
docs.text: Yes. Go to Settings → Export Data to download your tasks as .csv or .json.

docs.title: 📆 What happens if a task passes its due date?
docs.text: The task remains active but will be marked as overdue. You can reschedule it or update its status anytime.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Welcome to TechDocsHub! This guide will help you get started with the platform.

docs.title: 1. Sign Up
docs.text:
To create an account:

  1. Go to https://techdocshub.example.com
  2. Click Sign Up
  3. Enter your email and create a password
  4. Confirm your email via the activation link

⚠️ Tip: Use a strong password and a valid email address.

docs.title: 2. Log In
docs.text: After signing up, log in with your email and password at https://techdocshub.example.com/login

docs.title: 3. Explore the Dashboard
docs.text:
Once logged in, you’ll see:

  • 📋 Your task board
  • 📆 Upcoming deadlines
  • 👥 Team overview

Click “Create Task” to begin managing your work.

docs.title: 4. Next Steps
docs.text:
• Check out the User Guide to learn how to organize projects
  • See the API Reference if you're a developer

docs.title: User Guide
docs.text: This guide walks you through the core features of TechDocsHub — how to create, manage, and organize your tasks effectively.

docs.title: 📋 Creating a New Task
docs.text:
1. Click the “Create Task” button on the top right of your dashboard.
  2. In the modal that opens, enter:
  3. Task Name (e.g. "Write product brief")
  4. Description (optional)
  5. Due Date
  6. Priority Level (Low, Medium, High)
  7. Click Save.

✅ Your task will now appear in the “To Do” column of your board.

docs.title: ✏️ Editing a Task
docs.text:
1. Hover over the task card and click the pencil icon ✎.
  2. Modify the task fields as needed.
  3. Click Update Task.

docs.title: 🚮 Deleting a Task
docs.text:
1. Click the task card to open it.
  2. Click the Delete button at the bottom.
  3. Confirm the action.

⚠️ Deleting a task is permanent.

docs.title: 📌 Organizing Tasks
docs.text:
You can organize tasks using drag & drop:

  • Move tasks between columns: “To Do”, “In Progress”, “Done”
  • Use filters (top right) to show:
  • Only your assigned tasks
  • Tasks due this week
  • Tasks by tag (e.g. #urgent)

docs.title: 👥 Adding Team Members
docs.text:
1. Go to the Team tab in the sidebar.
  2. Click Invite Member
  3. Enter their email and assign a role:
  4. Viewer (read-only)
  5. Contributor (edit tasks)
  6. Admin (full access)

The invitee will receive an email with a link to join your workspace.

docs.title: ✅ Next Steps
docs.text:
• Use tags to track task categories (#marketing, #dev)
  • View analytics in the Reports tab
  • Learn how to automate tasks in the API Reference
